description: Creates or fully replaces one named admin page set for this account — real file source (React/Next.js), not text config. purchase_scaffold's admin_page_set param bakes a chosen set into a brand-new, dedicated repo. An account may keep more than one named set.

files.description: The full set of files, e.g. [{ path: "app/admin/page.tsx", content: "..." }].

name.description: Name for this set, e.g. "default" or "acme-admin".

name: set_adminpageset
title: Set admin page set
